Complaints Undertaken
There had been a £10 payment via my debit card today 02.01.2026. I havent used or been able to access my money since 30.12.2025. I want to know how on earth you tbink its acceptable to take £10 out of my account while I have no access to it! This was my beneifts money from DWP. I owe nothing to you, so why has £10 been taken out? I was threatened to be evicted from the bank from saying this was fraud and not sky bet. I was waiting for nearly an hour for my OWN benefits money in the bank. Embarrassing having to beg for my own benefits back. I think this is fraud that £10 has been taken. In all my years of being an adult no bank has ever taken a random £10 out.
